description.value: Glenora Trails Head Park is a Cowichan Valley Regional District park near Duncan on Vancouver Island, providing trailhead access to the Glenora trail network. It sits along the Vancouver Crossing Loop cycling route, making it a natural rest or navigation waypoint for touring cyclists travelling through the Cowichan Valley. As a regional district facility, it offers a natural forested setting typical of the southern Vancouver Island landscape.
